title: Cross out the repeats
prompt:
The order sheet lists some parts twice. Build a list named `unique` that keeps each part once, in the order it first appears.

When it works, `python3 dedupe.py` prints `['gear', 'fuse', 'spring', 'bolt']`.
hints: Go through `orders` one part at a time. For each part, ask: is it already on my new list?
`part in unique` is `True` when the part is already on the list, and `not in` asks the opposite.
Inside the loop: `if part not in unique:` then `unique.append(part)`.
explain_after:
You checked each part against the list you were building and appended only new ones. `append` adds to the end, so first appearances keep their order [py-073].

The next job, the Filing Cabinet, shows a set: a collection with no duplicates at all [py-080].
